chapter_title: How to Stick With Good Habits Every Day
narration_script: The best way to stick with good habits is to track them. Habit tracking is a simple way to measure whether you did a habit. It also provides immediate evidence that you are becoming the person you want to be. Each mark on the calendar is a vote for your identity. Habit tracking also keeps you honest. It is hard to ignore the evidence of a blank calendar. But do not let tracking become obsessive. The most important rule is to never miss twice. If you miss a day get back on track immediately. One slip up is not a new pattern.
